key_orgs.name: Nature Conservation Foundation (NCF)
key_orgs.data: Wildlife research reports (elephant, hornbill, snow leopard, human-wildlife conflict); species occurrence via GBIF publishing partners; https://www.ncf-india.org/

key_orgs.name: Ashoka Trust for Research in Ecology and the Environment (ATREE)
key_orgs.data: Watershed/biodiversity/community-forestry research; India Biodiversity Portal co-founder; species & landscape datasets via IBP/GBIF; https://www.atree.org/

key_orgs.name: Keystone Foundation
key_orgs.data: Nilgiri biosphere ecology-livelihood studies, honey-trail/ethnobotany reports; limited open GIS; https://keystone-foundation.org/

key_orgs.name: Foundation for Ecological Security (FES)
key_orgs.data: Community forest commons maps, restoration monitoring, village forest governance data; https://fes.org.in/

key_orgs.name: India Biodiversity Portal (IBP)
key_orgs.data: Open species occurrence API + citizen-science observations; GBIF publisher 62431bdf-fa0c-452b-afce-be14884a47ff; https://indiabiodiversity.org/

key_orgs.name: Bird Count India / SoIB
key_orgs.data: State of India's Birds 2023 trend CSVs on Zenodo (CC-BY); https://zenodo.org/records/11124590 ; https://stateofindiasbirds.in/

key_orgs.name: Wildlife Institute of India (WII) + Wildlife Trust of India (WTI)
key_orgs.data: Elephant Corridors of India 2023 atlas (Project Elephant/MoEFCC) — PDF atlas, not open GIS; https://www.wii.gov.in/

key_orgs.name: Forest Survey of India (FSI)
key_orgs.data: India State of Forest Report LULC/forest-cover maps & reports; https://fsi.nic.in/

key_orgs.name: Dakshin Foundation
key_orgs.data: Coastal/marine biodiversity & fisheries livelihood research; https://dakshin.org/
